plot_images_horizontally: plot a list of NumPy images horizontally with optional titles and adaptive figure sizing
plot_keypoints_on_images: plot keypoints as scatter points on existing matplotlib image axes with custom colors
plot_matches_between_images: plot matching keypoints between two images with colored connecting lines and endpoint markers
add_text_to_axis: add labeled text with outline effects to a specific axis in the current figure
features_to_RGB: project high-dimensional feature maps to RGB colors using PCA for visualization
